status: Analytical review and candidate interface; no scientific status promotion

analytical_additions.claim: Mean local signature frequency is exactly topology-independent under identical independent global-edge sampling on an ordinary fixed simplicial complex.
conditions: The triangulation is fixed, or sampled independently of edge intervals.
There are no global constraints or action-dependent weights on the edge measure.

analytical_additions.claim: Adjacent same-signature covariance equals Var(conditional signature probability given their common face).
conditions: Two distinct 4-simplices share exactly one tetrahedral face.
All global edges are iid; the eight nonshared edges are conditionally independent.

analytical_additions.claim: Mixed-domain positive Euclidean probability equals 2^-10 times the positive-edge Euclidean probability.
conditions: Ten independent fair sign choices, independent of the iid magnitudes.

next_scientific_decision: Specify physically justified q_ij and their induced joint measure before importing this candidate into the project.
